newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 10-yr note seen yielding 6.37/6.38 pc.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 10-yr note seen yielding 6.37/6.38 pc.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $12.0 billion in 10-year notes on Thursday is expected to produce a yield between 6.37 and 6.38 percent, dealers said.
The offering will settle February 18. The entire refunding operation will raise $21.75 billion in new cash.
At 1237 EST/1737 GMT, the 10-year notes were quoted at 6.365 percent in when-issued trade.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EST/1800 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
